import numpy as np

# Data from 1942 Treasury Bulletin - Individual income tax receipts (net of refunds)
# These are in thousands of dollars
years = [1929, 1930, 1931, 1932, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942]
receipts_thousands = [1095541, 1146845, 833648, 427191, 352573, 419509, 527113, 674416, 1091741, 1286312, 1028834, 982017, 1417655, 3262800]

# Convert to billions of dollars (divide by 1,000,000)
receipts = [r / 1000000 for r in receipts_thousands]

print("Data for regression (year, receipts in billions):")
for y, r in zip(years, receipts):
    print(f"  {y}: {r:.6f}")

# Fit OLS regression: receipts = beta0 + beta1 * year
X = np.array(years)
y = np.array(receipts)

# Calculate regression coefficients
n = len(years)
sum_x = np.sum(X)
sum_y = np.sum(y)
sum_xy = np.sum(X * y)
sum_x2 = np.sum(X ** 2)

beta1 = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x ** 2)
beta0 = (sum_y - beta1 * sum_x) / n

print(f"\nRegression: receipts = {beta0:.6f} + {beta1:.6f} * year")

# Project for year 2000
year_2000 = 2000
projected_2000 = beta0 + beta1 * year_2000
print(f"\nProjected receipts for FY 2000: {projected_2000:.6f} billion dollars")

# Actual receipts for FY 2000 from 2001 Treasury Bulletin (in millions)
actual_2000_millions = 1004461
actual_2000 = actual_2000_millions / 1000  # Convert to billions
print(f"Actual receipts for FY 2000: {actual_2000:.3f} billion dollars")

# Difference
difference = actual_2000 - projected_2000
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {difference:.3f} billion dollars")
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(difference, 1)}")
EOF
